scope: Second search — Backlog 2 Batch 012; S2147 additive Table 4 injury-location incidence, burden, and median-severity correction

papers.sourceCoverage: Primary PDF, Table 4 (PDF p. 7; journal p. 455): direct all-injury location incidence, burden, and median time loss across the four-season pooled follow-up. These source values belong on the existing Total population line only.
mappings: Head/face → head; Neck/cervical spine → neck; Hip and groin → the established groin field, retaining the source's combined label scope.
Shoulder, lumbosacral, abdomen, thigh, knee, lower leg, ankle, and foot map directly to their like-named location fields.

Upper arm/elbow/forearm, wrist and hand, chest and thoracic spine, and ACL injury are intentionally not forced into a single injury-location field. Concussion is already represented in the tissue/type family and is outside this location-only correction.
